reasons.observation: The Best Buy URL path ends in /openbox, so the linked offer is an open-box listing even though offers[0].condition says new.
Both titles are Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen), the same model and generation. The competitor title only adds Wireless Noise-Canceling.
Both listings have Color: Black selected, so the variant matches.
The IDs differ (mgo7x7F vs GrrCAIt), but Channel3 can list one product under several IDs. Brand, category, title and color all agree.
The condition field says new, but the URL path and Channel3's merging of open-box pages into new records make it unreliable here.

decision.customer_message: The competitor's listing is the same Bose QuietComfort Ultra (2nd Gen) in Black, but it is an open-box item, not new. It does not qualify as a like-for-like new product.
